newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-Berg cover started with buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-Berg cover started with buy.

text.p: Barrington Research Associates said it began covering Berg Electronics Inc with a buy rating for long-term growth investors.
Berg, a St. Louis, Mo.-based manufacturer of electronic connectors, has grown through acquisition to become the fourth largest connector manufacturer in the world, it said.
Berg's emphasis on new product development, cost reduction and market share will fuel earnings growth through 1990, said analyst Walter Liptak in a report.
Shares of Berg were trading off 2/16 to 39-5/16.
